_source: live /api/tools — the real agentic tool surface, descriptions as the backend states them. Trimmed, not embellished.

tools.name: describe_robot
tools.what: Serialize a robot into LLM-readable tokens + a grounded description

tools.name: diagnose_body
tools.what: Physics-free structural read: DOF, reach, end effector, limb count

tools.name: nearest_bodies
tools.what: Prior bodies most morphologically similar to the prompt's body

tools.name: recall_knowledge
tools.what: Prior tips, lessons and reusable skills, keyed by morphology

tools.name: search_memory
tools.what: Most similar prior designs/runs from the design flywheel memory

tools.name: evaluate_robot
tools.what: Compose a robot and score it on its task — real MuJoCo

tools.name: design_search
tools.what: Bounded, physics-verified search over a body's parameters

tools.name: build_robot
tools.what: Compose + physics-build a buildable robot, warm-started from memory

tools.name: design_brain
tools.what: The moat, measured: niche coverage, QD-score, provenance compounding
